prompt.zh-TW: 大東想知道河岸麵包坊「本業」今年到底做得好不好。下列哪一種看法說得通？
prompt.en: Tung wants to know how well Riverside Bakery’s core business actually did this year. Which of these views makes sense?

text.zh-TW: 看營業利益，因為它只包含賣麵包的收入、成本與銷管費用
text.en: Look at operating profit, because it includes only bread sales, their cost and distribution costs and administrative expenses

feedback.zh-TW: 說得通。營業利益就是為了回答「本業賺不賺」而設的那一層。
feedback.en: That works. Operating profit is the level designed to answer whether the core business earns money.

text.zh-TW: 看營業毛利，因為它說明麵包本身賣得划不划算
text.en: Look at gross profit, because it shows whether the bread itself sells at a worthwhile margin

feedback.zh-TW: 也說得通。營業毛利回答的是「產品本身」賺不賺，是本業的第一道關卡。
feedback.en: That also works. Gross profit asks whether the product itself makes money, the first test of the core business.

text.zh-TW: 看本期淨利，再把供應商付的違約金也算成本業的成績
text.en: Look at profit for the period, and count the supplier’s penalty payment as part of the core business

feedback.zh-TW: 本期淨利確實是最後留下來的數字，這點沒錯。但違約金是一次性的業外收益，把它算進本業會高估今年的經營成果。
feedback.en: Profit for the period is indeed the figure finally kept, that much is right. But the penalty is a one-off gain outside the core business; counting it would overstate this year’s trading result.

text.zh-TW: 看營業收入，收入越高本業就做得越好
text.en: Look at revenue; the higher it is, the better the core business did

feedback.zh-TW: 收入成長確實值得高興，這點沒錯。不過收入高不代表賺錢：如果麵粉和人事費漲得更兇，收入再高也可能虧損。
feedback.en: Growing revenue is indeed good news, that much is right. But high revenue does not mean profit: if flour and staff costs rose even faster, the business could lose money however high the revenue.

explanation.zh-TW: 本業的成績要看還沒混進業外項目的那幾層：{{option:o_e3dm}}與{{option:o_kbb2}}都是，差別只在有沒有扣掉營業費用，所以選哪一個都說得通。{{option:o_fv74}}混進了一次性的業外收益，{{option:o_q2th}}只看收入不看成本。
explanation.en: The core business is judged at the levels before non-operating items enter: both {{option:o_e3dm}} and {{option:o_kbb2}} qualify, differing only in whether operating expenses have been deducted, so either is reasonable. {{option:o_fv74}} mixes in a one-off non-operating gain, and {{option:o_q2th}} looks at revenue without costs.
